messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Output count of last value received
messages.description: Using the number most recently received in the left inlet,reports out the right outlet how many times that number has been received, and sends the number itself out the left outlet. If no number has been previously received in the left inlet,is sent out both outlets.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Erases the memory of, to begin a new histogram.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: Has the same effect as a number in the left inlet, except that the number is not counted by.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet:keeps count of how many times it has received a number between 0 and 127 in the left inlet. When a number is received,includes it in the count, sends the number of times that number has been received out the right outlet, and passes the number itself out the left outlet. Numbers outside the range 0-127 are ignored.
